title: Without permission to change the Bill To the Credit Hold banner has no button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work orders → View' but not 'Work orders → Create & Edit', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Credit Hold credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.
  • The banner reads "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer B's name], is on Credit Hold"
  • The banner has no "Change Bill To" button.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
